name: Sergius Paulus
bio: Sergius Paulus, the Roman proconsul of Cyprus, was described as a prudent man who summoned Barnabas and Saul to hear the word of God. When the sorcerer Bar-jesus tried to turn him from the faith and was struck blind at Saul's word, Sergius Paulus believed, astonished at the teaching of the Lord (Acts 13:7-12).
